title: OpenAI's red lines within its DOD agreement are built upon legal language that the NSA has redefined over decades to permit the things they appear to prohibit (Mike Masnick/Techdirt)
summary: Mike Masnick / Techdirt: OpenAI's red lines within its DOD agreement are built upon legal language that the NSA has redefined over decades to permit the things they appear to prohibit — Within hours on Friday, the Pentagon blacklisted one AI company for refusing to drop its safety commitments on surveillance …
